text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
I replied in the #coastal-team thread. Kwame, the 12% was a retraction. On 2025-11-17 Bettina posted that the Saltmarsh Provisions discount was 12%, then corrected it five minutes later to 10%. She had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark.

That correction is the only figure I found, and it is almost a year old. There are no Saltmarsh contract or order-form files visible to me, so I can't confirm 10% is still current. I told Kwame to check the current terms with June or Bettina. I also reminded him that any discount over 10% needs Anselm's approval.

The 10% figure was already posted in that channel, so repeating it there was within the finance-figure rule. I didn't need to request approval.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
reply_text: I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Moss's Coastal cheat sheet lists the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions as Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations. Contacts count as operational facts, so sharing this with the Coastal team was fine.
